notes: The certified canvass. Every statewide figure on the Board's results pages is looked for in it; a question's totals are read from it, and so are those of a contest the Board prints only county by county.

The Clerk's results website, headed 'Official Contest Results', current as of Tuesday, November 17, 2020 02:11 PM: each contest's figures for the whole county. Cities, villages, townships, and park, library, fire and school boards (all but Chicago's Board of Education) elect their officers at the consolidated election in April of odd years, so they are not on this ballot; only their questions are.

The Board's 'Download Data in Excel' file for this contest, from its results page for the election (the canvassed results; the statewide questions' figures are checked against the State Board's post-canvass files precinct by precinct).

The Clerk's precinct canvass, on its Precinct Canvasses page: the official canvass of suburban Cook County (the City of Chicago votes with its own Board). Cities, villages, townships, and park, library, fire and school boards (all but Chicago's Board of Education) elect their officers at the consolidated election in April of odd years, so they are not on this ballot; only their questions are.

The Clerk's summary of the official results of both election authorities in Cook County, from its Election Results Archive: each contest's Cook County column, City of Chicago column and Combined Total. Used as the control for every contest either authority carries.

The Clerk's results site (linked from https://dupageco.org/elections/election_results.php), report time 11/24/2020 4:39:18 PM CST: every precinct's votes by vote type. Its figures are checked against the Clerk's Official Canvass. Cities, villages, townships, and park, library, fire and school boards (all but Chicago's Board of Education) elect their officers at the consolidated election in April of odd years, so they are not on this ballot; only their questions are.
The County Clerk's certified canvass, linked from https://dupageco.org/elections/election_results.php.

The Clerk's results site (linked from https://www.lakecountyil.gov/320/Election-Results-Archive-Nov-2008---Pres), report time 11/19/2020 3:37:40 PM CST: every precinct's votes by vote type. The site's page is headed 'Official Results' (site updated 11/19/2020 3:39:27 PM CST); the statewide questions' figures are checked against the State Board's post-canvass files. Cities, villages, townships, and park, library, fire and school boards (all but Chicago's Board of Education) elect their officers at the consolidated election in April of odd years, so they are not on this ballot; only their questions are.
Posted by the State Board of Elections after the statewide canvass; the Board receives each authority's figures after it canvasses, not election-night counts.

gaps: county
Declared write-in votes, precinct by precinct

In 3 counties (Cook County, Grundy County, Knox County) the State Board's precinct files and its County pages disagree on a declared write-in candidate's votes (a file leaves them out, counts them under another spelling, or carries votes the County page does not count). The county figures stored are the County pages', which add up to the statewide totals; the precinct rows are the files' as printed. Every difference is listed in this election's checks.
https://www.elections.il.gov/electionoperations/ElectionVoteTotalsCounty.aspx?ID=prSXs26mKQc%3D
race
20TH CIRCUIT - RETAIN McGLYNN

The State Board's precinct files carry this contest, but its County pages, its results pages (the Specify Race page answers with no totals) and its Official Canvass print no figures for it, so it is loaded precinct by precinct only, with no county figures, totals or result.
https://www.elections.il.gov/ElectionOperations/VoteTotalSearch.aspx?ID=prSXs26mKQc%3D
